args.task: Given the macro context of a "Risk-On" equity regime with stable rates, rising inflation and GDP, easing liquidity, and tight credit spreads, perform a head-to-head financial analysis of Apple (AAPL) and Microsoft (MSFT). Evaluate their revenue growth, profit margins, balance sheet strength, and overall financial health. Compare their performance in these areas and discuss how the current macro environment might specifically impact their financial outlook. Provide a detailed comparison to determine which company exhibits stronger financial fundamentals in this environment.
